title: My dash cam filmed a passenger 🚗
style_prompt: dark blue cinematic night, faceless silhouette, fog, minimal interior, no text, no watermark
hook_text: At 12:58 in the morning, my dash cam saved a clip I never recorded.

scenes.narration: At 12:58 in the morning, my dash cam saved a clip I never recorded.
The car was parked outside my flat. Engine off. Keys on my kitchen table. I was at home.
The notification said, parking mode, motion detected. I opened the clip.
The camera looked through the windscreen. Someone sat in the driver's seat. Hands on the wheel. Not moving.
I could not see the face. Only the back of the head. And the breath on the glass, spreading, then fading.
The next clip showed two shapes in front. And a third, in the back seat, facing the camera.
I walked to the window and looked down. The car was there. Dark. Still. Both front seats looked empty.
The last clip was from tonight. It showed the street, then my front door, from the car's point of view. The car was watching my door open.
And I was walking out of it. Toward the car. I did not remember leaving the flat. The clip had sound. I was saying, I am coming.
So tell me. Do you look in the back seat, or just drive?
